description: Build the minimal messaging substrate that Phase 5 depends on, plus the Google Calendar update/delete operations reschedule and cancel need. Phase 4 left only a stub: lib/queue.ts enqueueSendMessage() points at MESSAGE_QUEUE but there is NO `messages` table, NO send-message worker consumer, and NO whatsapp/sms send functions. Phase 5's spec explicitly requires marking a message `failed` and references the messages table, so this substrate is in-scope for Phase 5. Scope it minimally: a Message table (booking, channel, template, status, provider id, error) with a hand-written Prisma migration; a pluggable delivery layer (lib/messaging.ts) that tries WhatsApp then falls back to SMS, with INJECTABLE send functions (default implementations are safe no-op/log stubs because real Meta/MSG91 delivery needs approved templates + network that are unavailable - document this assumption in a comment); and the send-message worker consumer. Also add updateEvent + deleteEvent to lib/google.ts's GoogleClient interface and createGoogleClient factory, reusing the existing GoogleReconnect/Request/Transient error taxonomy. This feature leaves confirmation messages actually sendable and gives Phase 5 reminders/reschedule/cancel a real messages layer to record against. ASSUMPTION (document in code + findings): full Phase 4 real-provider integration and the WhatsApp delivery-status webhook are NOT built here - only the substrate Phase 5 needs, with injectable senders. This feature is independent of FEAT-003/FEAT-004 code but must land first because they build on it.
steps: In prisma/schema.prisma add enums MessageChannel { WHATSAPP SMS } and MessageStatus { PENDING SENT DELIVERED FAILED } and a Message model with: id, bookingId (relation to Booking, onDelete Cascade), channel (MessageChannel), template (String), status (MessageStatus default PENDING), providerId (String? @map provider_id), error (String?), createdAt, updatedAt. Follow the exact mapping/@@map/@@index conventions used by Payment and Booking (snake_case @map, @@map("messages"), @@index([bookingId])). Add `messages Message[]` back-relation on Booking.

Write a hand-written migration prisma/migrations/20261010000000_messages/migration.sql following the style of prisma/migrations/20261009000000_google_meet/migration.sql: CreateEnum for MessageChannel and MessageStatus, CreateTable messages with snake_case columns and defaults matching the schema, CreateIndex on booking_id, and AddForeignKey messages_booking_id_fkey -> bookings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE. Do NOT run prisma migrate (registry blocked) - the SQL is authored by hand.

Create lib/messaging.ts: a sendMessageForBooking(bookingId, template, overrides?) business-logic function mirroring lib/meeting.ts structure. It re-reads the latest booking (with session->service->influencer and whatsapp fields) at run time; skips if the booking is not in a messageable state (e.g. CANCELLED/EXPIRED/FAILED) or whatsappOptIn is false; upserts/creates a Message row keyed deterministically on (bookingId, template) so retries do not duplicate rows; tries WhatsApp via an injectable sender, on failure falls back to SMS; records provider id on success (status SENT) or error on failure; and after a thrown transient failure rethrows so BullMQ retries. Expose a MessagingDeps interface with sendWhatsApp, sendSms, alert, prisma-independent injection following the MeetingDeps pattern. Default sendWhatsApp/sendSms live in lib/whatsapp.ts and lib/sms.ts.

Create lib/whatsapp.ts and lib/sms.ts with a documented injectable send function each (e.g. sendWhatsAppTemplate(to, template, params) / sendSms(to, body)). Default implementation: if the provider env vars (WHATSAPP_TOKEN etc.) are absent, log a structured line and succeed (so the pipeline is exercisable without real providers); include a clearly-marked TODO that real Meta Cloud API / SMS provider calls belong here (Phase 4 completion). This keeps Phase 5 testable while not fabricating provider credentials.

Add reportMessageFailure(bookingId, template, message, alert?) to lib/messaging.ts: called after the final retry; marks the Message row FAILED, records booking.lastError for the dashboard flag, and alerts the influencer via alertInfluencer. Add a new InfluencerAlertKind 'message-delivery-failed' to lib/alerts.ts InfluencerAlertKind union.

Create worker/jobs/sendMessage.ts: BullMQ handler calling sendMessageForBooking; wrap unrecoverable domain errors in UnrecoverableError, rethrow transient ones for backoff (mirror worker/jobs/createMeeting.ts).

Add updateEvent(accessToken, eventId, patch) and deleteEvent(accessToken, eventId) to the GoogleClient interface and createGoogleClient() in lib/google.ts. updateEvent PATCHes /calendars/primary/events/<id>?sendUpdates=all (start/end/summary/description) and returns the updated CalendarEvent via toCalendarEvent; deleteEvent DELETEs the event (treat 404/410 as already-gone success). Reuse readError + classifyCalendarError and the GoogleReconnect/Request/Transient taxonomy exactly as insertEvent/getEvent do. Update the CALENDAR_SCOPE comment is already correct (events scope covers update+delete).

Wire the send-message consumer into worker/index.ts following the meetings Worker shape: guarded by REDIS_URL, concurrency, error + failed listeners, and a `failed` handler that on exhausted attempts (and not UnrecoverableError) calls reportMessageFailure; add it to graceful shutdown (close the worker). Register it on MESSAGE_QUEUE.

Add tests/messaging.test.ts in the pure-logic style (node:test, inject fake deps - fake prisma or DB-skip guard like payments.test.ts, fake sendWhatsApp/sendSms). Cover: WhatsApp success records SENT + provider id; WhatsApp failure falls back to SMS; both fail -> throws (retryable) and does not mark SENT; a CANCELLED/opt-out booking is skipped. If a Message-table assertion needs the DB, guard with `const skip = process.env.DATABASE_URL ? false : 'DATABASE_URL not set'` like the existing integration tests.
acceptance_criteria: prisma/schema.prisma defines Message model + MessageChannel + MessageStatus enums with snake_case @map and @@map("messages"), and Booking has a messages back-relation
prisma/migrations/20261010000000_messages/migration.sql exists and matches the schema (enums, messages table, index, FK) in the established hand-written style
lib/messaging.ts, lib/whatsapp.ts, lib/sms.ts, and worker/jobs/sendMessage.ts exist and compile at the syntax level
lib/google.ts GoogleClient has updateEvent and deleteEvent implemented via the shared error taxonomy
worker/index.ts registers a send-message Worker on MESSAGE_QUEUE with error/failed listeners and graceful shutdown, and reports failure after exhausted attempts
tests/messaging.test.ts exists and follows the project's node:test style
verification: Run `unset NODE_OPTIONS && tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck lib/messaging.ts lib/whatsapp.ts lib/sms.ts lib/google.ts worker/jobs/sendMessage.ts worker/index.ts` and confirm no syntax/type errors OTHER than unresolved-module errors for '@/...', 'bullmq', 'next', and '@/generated/prisma' (those are environment noise because node_modules is empty). Fix every real error.
Read the migration SQL against the schema and confirm columns, defaults, enum values, index, and FK all match.
NOTE for CI (cannot run here): `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` must pass after `npm install` + `npx prisma generate`.
findings: Implemented the Phase 5 messaging substrate and Google event update/delete. ASSUMPTIONS documented in code: (1) lib/whatsapp.ts and lib/sms.ts default senders are log-and-succeed stubs when provider env vars (WHATSAPP_TOKEN/WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID, SMS_API_KEY) are absent, because real Meta Cloud API / MSG91 delivery needs approved templates + DLT registration + network that are unavailable here; a clearly-marked TODO(phase-4) marks where the real calls belong. (2) The WhatsApp delivery-status webhook and full Phase 4 provider integration are NOT built here, only the substrate Phase 5 depends on. DESIGN NOTES: Message rows are keyed on a @@unique([bookingId, template]) so retries upsert the same row (no duplicates); this unique key is required by the upsert in sendMessageForBooking. sendMessageForBooking mirrors lib/meeting.ts (run-time booking re-read with session->service->influencer, skip for non-sendable status CANCELLED/EXPIRED/FAILED/HELD/PENDING_PAYMENT or whatsappOptIn=false, WhatsApp->SMS fallback via injectable MessagingDeps, SENT+providerId on success, error recorded + rethrow on transient both-channel failure). reportMessageFailure marks the row FAILED, sets booking.lastError, and alerts via the new 'message-delivery-failed' InfluencerAlertKind. worker/index.ts registers the send-message Worker on MESSAGE_QUEUE with the meetings-Worker shape (REDIS_URL guard, concurrency 5, error+failed listeners, failed handler calls reportMessageFailure only when attempts exhausted and not UnrecoverableError, graceful shutdown close). lib/google.ts updateEvent PATCHes /calendars/primary/events/<id>?sendUpdates=all and deleteEvent treats 404/410 as already-gone success, both reusing readError+classifyCalendarError. VERIFICATION: per-file `tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck` (global TS 5.9.2) shows no real errors; only expected environment noise (TS2688 missing @types and TS2307 unresolved '@/...'/bullmq/next/ioredis) because node_modules is empty and the Prisma client cannot be generated here. `npm run typecheck`/`npm test` and `prisma generate`/`migrate` could not run (npm registry blocked, no Postgres/Redis) - CI must run them after merge. Migration SQL authored by hand (20261010000000_messages) matching the google_meet migration style.
